prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / new pose version.
IMAGE 1 = the character, armor, sword design, art style, atmosphere and background to preserve.
IMAGE 2 = the NEW POSE reference explicitly selected by the user. Match its body/leg stance, arm placement, sword angle and compact natural grip, but do not copy its gray background, watermark, heavier body proportions or 3D skin treatment.

Create a new pose version of IMAGE 1 using IMAGE 2. Reconstruct the pose coherently from the shoulder and elbow through the wrist to the hand, rather than patching the previous hand. Keep the same silver-haired adult male face, slightly slimmer athletic physique and fitted white/silver armor with gold trim and black undersuit; same angular pauldrons, chest plates, greaves and white cape. Maintain the original detailed 2D anime/painterly rendering and platinum/gold radiant sanctuary setting.

POSE: follow IMAGE 2 closely. Upright composed three-quarter stance with its natural hip/leg/foot placement, right arm resting downward beside the body, slight relaxed elbow bend, hand beside the outer upper thigh. Hold the sword extending diagonally DOWN-LEFT at the shallower angle shown in IMAGE 2, rather than the steep near-vertical angle of IMAGE 1. The whole sword rotates together as ONE RIGID OBJECT. Left hand is a compact relaxed armored fist at his other side. Keep full body and long balanced legs. Sword tip may be cropped offscreen; do not distort the pose to fit it.

RIGHT HAND: match the compact back-of-hand-facing closed grip in IMAGE 2. Show a normal human-sized dark armored gauntlet with silver backhand plates, about the same size as the other hand. Wrist, knuckles and hand form one natural anatomical continuation from the forearm. Fingers curl together around the handle and are mostly occluded by the fist; only naturally visible digits are shown. One thumb overlaps the curled fingers normally. Do NOT expose every finger separately, spread fingers, produce long segmented claws, duplicate digits or a swollen mechanical hand. A small readable normal closed fist is essential.

SWORD DESIGN LOCK: retain IMAGE 1's original elaborate wing/thorn gold crossguard, black-and-gold wrapped grip and pointed pommel, black recessed layered blade panels, silver cutting bevels, successive broad gold thorn ornaments and original width/taper. Preserve the sword's recognizable shapes and engraving, not a generic broad black slab, thin longsword or new ornament pattern.

SWORD CONSTRUCTION: FIRST place the entire existing sword in IMAGE 2's new orientation as one straight rigid structure. Pommel center, grip center, crossguard central socket and black blade's central backbone must all lie on the SAME uninterrupted straight diagonal axis. The handle enters the TRUE MIDDLE of the guard directly above the blade tang, never a side wing or offset notch. Keep the decorative thorn outlines while ensuring the underlying spine is straight and unbroken. THEN fit the compact fist and wrist naturally around the centered grip. No bending parts to meet the hand.

Preserve the magnificent original atmosphere, colors, face identity, fine natural silver hair, slim armor design, premium materials and cape. Pose adjustments are expressly authorized; avoid carrying over the malformed hand from prior edits. No text, logo, watermark, UI, guide lines or extra weapons. Deliver one finished full-body 2:3 portrait illustration.
